name: create_magic_link
title: Create magic link
description: Most important ops tool. Prefills the factory from the website, allowlists domain↔email, and returns a one-click claim URL. Refuses already-live factories. Optional company_id pins the row. Optional niche keeps PCBA/EMS out of the CNC default.

company_id.description: Optional: pin to an existing company row

niche.description: Optional manufacturing category slug, e.g. pcba. Unknown values become other, not cnc.

demand_id.description: Optional unmatched gap demand id — claim link includes demand context.
